risk_note: RV2 (ledger, settlement). Recon difference conclusions (CT-24zf; 08 BR-FUND-04 ④, 校验结果表, 例 2; D10-447 ②, D10-506, D10-507 ②). closeAdminReconDiff writes resolution.outcome for settle_amount_mismatch of source R1 only (others 20001 [outcome]), a close without outcome drops any stored key. readUnionAuthoritativeOrderKeys now reads closed union conclusions with their expected / actual, latest closed per amount state, by exact ref_id or an anchored #AMT# suffix, via unnest for large key sets. The bill job and supplement launch count an order as matching only while the current base and B_settle equal a conclusion's amounts; otherwise they compare as usual, and a mismatch with no difference of this bill at these amounts opens {order_key}#AMT#{base}:{b_settle} (dedupe by the business key), the order stays WAITING. Money effect: a union conclusion lets the order into a batch on the union's settled amount; nothing else is credited. diffFen in job and supplement corrected to expected − actual (D10-507 ②), two frozen B2-04r expectations follow in a separate test(spec) commit; the other ten tests of the file are red_exempt. Contract shape unchanged. Test-machine full verification verify/4 exit 0 (tree c9d4d172, PROP_RUNS=2000).
